who-this-is-for.text: Anyone who runs the rename script on a pre-rename branch and expects every text kind scanned and a gate that passes a clean tree.

what-was-broken.text: Two self-inflicted defects: the gate failed main itself over citation lines its hand allowlist missed, and shell scripts were never scanned, so one kept a product export past the rename.

what-you-can-do.text: Run the script twice on a scratch worktree: first run completes with the gate passing, second is a byte-for-byte no-op. The sequence diagram shows both runs plus the planted stray that must fail.

acceptance-from-the-shipped-issue-and-pr.text: Docs checks green including the new test, which is why this slice is bound by just ci itself. Twice-run proof, planted-stray failure naming the file, both falsification directions observed, merge commit on green.

deviations.text: Every ticket item implemented, no departure found, no question raised.

limits-of-this-slice.text: Underscored tokens stay invisible to the word grep, which is why scanning shells matters. Both citation spacings match. Tool and test are exempt. No product behaviour changes.
